hypothesis: If frozen INT8 H3 produces all thirty layer-aligned current-observation K/V prefixes online while FACT future/state/value tracks update those same thirty ActionDiT blocks, then future-prediction supervision will improve episode-disjoint action conditioning without the train/deploy gap of stored H3 features.
single_variable: Relative to C58 online frozen-H3 action training, add FACT clean-action, future-H3, future-state and value tracks plus official failure action masks inside the same thirty ActionDiT blocks; H3 checkpoint, online packing, action contract, dense windows and optimizer parent remain fixed.
parent_baseline: The fixed online C58b s10000 checkpoint initialized from D0-H32-s14000 SHA256 36c5615746fcd57f834db4cdbedd7a124174fca634786e1353871ded6b6e6de3. C56b may not start from C58b s10/s1000/intermediate or directly from D0.

references.title: FACT: Failure-Aware Causal Training for World-Action Models
C56b no-cache online data boundary and shared FACT tower
references.revision: f23d09b plus the strict C58b-s10000 final-parent gate

architecture.field: online frozen world prefix and shared action/consequence blocks
architecture.paper: P/A/G/V/I use one causal video transformer and future losses update the action-generating backbone.
architecture.upstream_code: One Wan causal transformer runs teacher-forced tracks; VAE latents may be cached but transformer K/V is not a training dataset artifact.
architecture.local: Every rank runs the pinned INT8 H3 online with no gradients, materializes all thirty layer-aligned current-observation K/V prefixes in memory, and jointly updates A/G/future-state/value/future-H3 tracks in the same thirty FACT blocks.
architecture.rationale: H3 replaces Wan and is frozen INT8 rather than jointly updated; all shared FACT action/consequence blocks remain trainable and all thirty received nonzero gradients in every real canary step.

data.field: expert, observational and causal-failure online inputs
data.paper: Expert and failure episodes share one transformed dataset; failure actions are masked.
data.upstream_code: EpisodeMixtureSampler chooses dataset, episode, then frame; WATransforms accepts online images or cached VAE latents.
data.local: Expert rows return existing VAE current/future latents; C48/C59 and C60 return current/future RGB from immutable trajectories. No row contains H3 K/V or H3 features.
data.rationale: Only the VAE boundary differs by stream; frozen H3 executes online for both and the collator forbids cached H3 fields.

action.field: LIBERO horizon32 absolute 7D and failure imitation mask
action.paper: Failed episode actions are excluded from imitation while future/value remain supervised.
action.upstream_code: action_loss_mask is zero for failure episodes.
action.local: C48 consumes audited C59 labels and C60 consumes embedded causal labels; environment/dataset gripper conversion is round-trip tested.
action.rationale: LIBERO absolute 7D horizon32 replaces RoboTwin delta14 horizon48 while retaining the deployed D0 action contract.

objective.paper: Action, future image, future state and value flow losses jointly update one backbone.
objective.upstream_code: wa_casual_trainer.py applies the four objectives and action failure mask.
objective.local: The port applies 10:1:0.4:0.4 action/future-H3/future-state/value flow losses with independent masks. Future-H3 targets are whitened with a 7168D train-only empirical mean/std computed online from frozen H3.
objective.rationale: Official FACT whitens Wan VAE latents with pretrained statistics; H3 K/V has no published upstream statistics, so train-split-only empirical whitening is a declared H3-port deviation. Raw target RMS 53.49984 becomes normalized RMS 1.0 without changing action predictions.

optimization.paper: Long multi-GPU training with separate parameter groups.
optimization.upstream_code: Resolved FACT config uses distributed training and episode mixture sampling.
optimization.local: Eight A800 ranks, microbatch1 and global batch8 use exact rank mixture 4 expert/2 success/1 observational failure/1 causal failure, AdamW base LR2e-5/action LR2e-4, warmup500 and cosine horizon10000. Ten real steps plus independent full-state restore passed; the long launcher saves and restores every 1000 steps.
optimization.rationale: FACT's separate parameter-group intent and distributed episode-mixture optimization are preserved; exact LR values and the four-stream LIBERO mixture are the pre-registered H3/LIBERO port contract.

evaluation.field: paired offline mechanism and fresh LIBERO closed loop
evaluation.upstream_code: Action generation is evaluated before consequence/value selection.
evaluation.local: C58 online is the fixed action-only parent; C56b must first preserve action conditioning and then beat it on fresh episode-disjoint LIBERO trials.
evaluation.rationale: LIBERO replaces RoboTwin and no effectiveness claim is made before paired rollout.

evidence: The real mixed-stream canary executes frozen online INT8 H3 and all thirty shared FACT blocks; every block has a finite positive gradient in all ten steps.
Synthetic demo and C60 tests prove no H3 cache crosses the dataset/collator boundary.
Action round-trip and failure masks are directly tested.

Train-only target normalization and the exact 4/2/1/1 mixed-rank balance gate passed; successful action loss is nonzero, both failure action losses are exactly zero, and future/action masks remain independent.
Ten optimizer steps on eight A800 ranks were finite; max C56 reserved memory was 57,491,324,928 bytes and steady step mean excluding initialization was 1.58653 s.
C58 online is pre-registered as the paired parent and fresh LIBERO success is decisive.

All thirty shared blocks had positive finite gradients in every real optimizer step (minimum observed mean-across-ranks block norm 2.32811); frozen H3 received no gradients and future-target-to-action leak remained exactly zero.
GO_LONG marker 9c87b9a3f7e8ebc803dacd13848a047a1d833e391a603eda0b4eb4b1489affdb records 10/10 finite mixed online steps.

The 12,201,948,249-byte s10 checkpoint SHA256 2d302b2cef4a2e9d1eb371a480cb235e50113c73267ae675de3ea5f735f39521 restored model, optimizer and scheduler strictly with prediction max_abs 0; restore report SHA256 6b18749fa1240804fb18b626d24011b099ba82d5ff8fa62e8f1875a7d5908f8a.

The parent arm is fixed as online C58b s10000 with FastWAM 45d8e145, INT8 H3 e889202c, D0 36c56157, seed42 and the layerwise 30-block contract. Runtime launch additionally requires the independent C58b final READY and matching checkpoint SHA256, so no intermediate parent is accepted.
The normalized mixed-batch gate proves non-dominating finite future/action gradients and no future-target leakage. This permits long optimization but is not held-out or rollout-effect evidence.
No online C56b checkpoint has run LIBERO.

budget.rank_mixture: 4 expert_demo + 2 success_rollout + 1 observational_failure + 1 causal_failure per optimizer step
budget.sampling_note: Each stream samples episode then frame, so window-epoch ratios report exposure but do not imply uniform-window sampling.
budget.estimated_hours_note: Steady optimizer estimate only; add ten 12.2GB checkpoint writes and independent restores, then re-estimate from s1000 wall time before claiming completion ETA.

decision.rationale: The online frozen-H3 architecture, mixed FACT objectives, memory, gradients and strict restore gates passed. Training permission is released, but the actual launch remains fail-closed until C58b s10000 has an independent strict-restore READY with matching checkpoint SHA256.
